qualification: Qualified native variants: IOMAD 4.5.13 / 4.5.15, 5.0.9 / 5.0.11, 5.1.8 and 5.2.4; historical 4.5.5 libraries under candidate qualification
knownlimitations: The older qualified native saved-file handler has a boolean-assignment precedence defect; its original-file link is not advertised. The corrected native handler is a separately qualified variant.
The qualified native activity restore omits saved original PDFs; confirmed administrative copies restore independently, but a new correction requires native saved-original evidence.
The qualified IOMAD 5.1/5.2 renderer omits the activity variable required by its templates. This adapter supplies an explicit local template scope without patching the native handler.
On IOMAD 5.1/5.2, saved-original evidence is read through Moodle File API to avoid the native reporting helper's deprecated file_encode_url call. Ambiguous or non-PDF files are refused.
